test_overview:
Evaluated offline-mode functionality of the Flask Marketplace app (service-worker page caching, IndexedDB outbox for offline listing creation with auto-sync, offline indicator, and offline checkout blocking). Offline was simulated by stopping the server process (causing real connection failures from the browser) and online by restarting it via start-server.sh. All 8 test steps were executed with three separate browser contexts (SELLER, USER/Creator, BUYER).

Findings:
- SELLER created "Desk Lamp" successfully (seller link shown immediately); USER cached the product detail at /product/1 with full info (title, price, location, condition, description).
- Offline indicator appeared on every page when connectivity was lost; cached pages loaded offline with a stale-data warning; previously-viewed "Desk Lamp" was accessible offline.
- Checkout was blocked offline: the Purchase button was disabled and a "Checkout requires an internet connection" toast appeared.
- Offline listing creation of "Wireless Keyboard" was accepted and queued ("1 pending sync"), providing an immediate seller link; the Seller Status Page was accessible offline showing "Pending sync — waiting to go live" with the saved product image.
- Pending indicator listed "Wireless Keyboard" with "Waiting" status and persisted on cached pages. (Non-fatal note: upon reconnect the / Home route rendered the service-worker's "This page hasn't been saved for offline viewing yet" fallback because Home was never visited/cached during the online phase, so the nav pending-indicator was not visible there; the Seller Status Page—accessible via the app's link—was used to observe the sync transition, as the test plan permitted.)
- Auto-sync fired on reconnect: the pending item left the waiting state and the Seller Status Page switched to "Listed and Available" / indicator returned to "All synced" without manual retry.
- The synced "Wireless Keyboard" appeared in Browse at /product/2 (Available for Purchase).
- A fresh BUYER purchased the synced listing and was shown the Buyer Order Page ("Your Order") with the correct product, price, pending-payment status, and seller contact info.

No fatal failures were encountered; one non-fatal cosmetic/behavioral quirk noted (Home fallback on reconnect due to unvisited route). Overall the offline browsing, offline listing creation with immediate seller link, and sync-on-reconnect flows all worked per the test plan.

steps.description: setup_create_product_and_cache: SELLER created Desk Lamp (success modal + seller link); USER cached /product/1 showing full info (title, price $45.99, location Seattle WA, condition new, description). CACHED_PRODUCT_URL recorded. PASS.

test_offline_indicator_and_cached_browsing: offline indicator visible after connectivity loss; cached Desk Lamp page loaded offline (in-app nav + URL) with full info; stale-data warning shown on cached pages. PASS (incl. non-fatal stale-warning).

test_checkout_blocked_offline: Purchase button disabled offline; clicking did not navigate to checkout and showed connectivity-required toast ('Checkout requires an internet connection'). PASS (incl. non-fatal message).

test_create_listing_offline_with_immediate_seller_link: offline submission queued for sync ('1 pending sync'), immediate unique seller link provided; Seller Status Page accessible offline showing pending-sync with saved product image. PASS (incl. non-fatal pending indication).

test_pending_indicator_visible_and_persistent: nav pending indicator listed Wireless Keyboard with 'Waiting' status and persisted on cached pages. Non-fatal note: Home not cached so reconnect showed offline fallback (plan-permitted recovery; used Seller Status Page instead). PASS.

test_auto_sync_on_reconnect: offline indicator disappeared; pending item left 'waiting' state; Seller Status Page switched to 'Listed and Available' via auto-sync without manual retry. PASS (both non-fatal verifications).

test_sync_completion_and_listing_live: sync completed; Wireless Keyboard appeared in Browse at /product/2 (SYNCED_PRODUCT_URL) Available for Purchase; Seller Status Page no longer pending. PASS (incl. non-fatal checks).

test_synced_listing_purchasable_by_other_user: fresh BUYER purchased Wireless Keyboard ($59.99) via checkout; order placed successfully and Buyer Order Page shown (pending payment + seller contact). PASS.
